verdict.rationale: Anthropic documents a first-party "Subscribe to webhooks" surface that notifies consumers of major state changes without polling. It is beta-gated behind the managed-agents-2026-04-01 header and scoped only to Managed Agents sessions, so it does not cover the broader API such as Messages or Batches. Missing for 10: webhook coverage beyond Managed Agents sessions (e.g. batch completion), GA status, documented registration, signing and retry semantics, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Although most real-time interactions occur through the SSE event stream, webhooks notify you of major state changes.
